text: I’m so stuck! I need to choose a major soon, but I’m torn between so many options. What are you planning to major in? I’m interested in mechanical engineering. It combines my interests in math and physics and offers strong career prospects. That sounds interesting! What made you decide on that particular major? I took several introductory courses in different fields and spoke to professors and professionals in each area. It helped me understand the workload, career paths, and what I truly enjoyed learning about. Talking to professionals is a great idea! I haven’t thought about that. Do you think professors would be open to answering questions about their fields? Absolutely! They’re passionate about their subjects and enjoy helping students find their path. Look for faculty office hours or career counseling services to connect with them. Thanks for the tip! I’ll definitely reach out to some professors and professionals in areas that interest me. Maybe that’ll help me narrow down my choices and find the right major. Good luck! Thanks again.
